Provides a resource to create a Waf object

> **NOTE:** If you need to change field `instanceId`, you need to keep `status` at `0`; If you need to change field `proxy(ip_headers)`, you need to keep `status` at `1`.

## Import



Waf object can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Waf/wafObject:WafObject example lb-9h5x9lze
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
